checks.method: Read the frozen manuscript and ledger, then independently opened https://arxiv.org/html/2609.06175v1 and inspected definitions, Section 6.3 and Section 8 with web.run.
checks.observation: The source uses finite distinct uniform members and permits empty cores, identifies the intersecting maximum as 27 in Proposition 6.8, and separates the upper-bound enumeration from the stated Lean scope. Those conventions match the manuscript. I did not rerun the enumeration.
checks.scope: External I27 attribution and compatible definitions

checks.method: Independently opened https://a1k.ai/agentic-math/rank-four-sunflower-free-families and compared its T3/T8 and status discussion with frozen Sections 1, 2 and 7.
checks.observation: The earlier report states I27 implies G81, leaves both literal A/B exclusions open, and records G80 as an unmet local goal. The present claimed contribution is framed as discharging those exclusions while retaining I27, which is a coherent advance relative to that source. This check establishes no global priority.
checks.scope: Contribution relative to the preceding A1K endpoint

findings.disposition: Retain explicit external-I27 and bounded-comparison qualifiers in later versions.
findings.statement: The numerical comparison is accurate within the named source family: 80 improves 83 by three and the earlier I27-dependent 81 endpoint by one. The manuscript does not claim that the earlier A1K development already proved unconditional local G81.

findings.disposition: Optional editorial clarification; current mathematical bounds remain interpretable.
findings.statement: The manuscript uses f(4,3) without a direct standalone definition of f, although the extremal interpretation follows from context and agrees with the external preprint. A short maximum-cardinality definition would avoid confusion with a forcing-threshold convention.

content.summary: The framing correctly distinguishes the new conditional upper bound from its ordinary corollary using an external computer-assisted theorem. Direct primary-page inspection supports the compared endpoints 83 and 81 and the claim that both profile exclusions remained open in the earlier A1K report. The text appropriately declines exhaustive priority; source mapping and proof-level comparison remain for later phases.
